name: SentenceCase
description: The heading rewritten in sentence case, keeping words like API and JavaScript as written, for a rule's suggest action.

name: TitleCase
description: The heading rewritten in title case, with short articles, conjunctions, and prepositions left lowercase, for a rule's suggest action.

name: errors
description: Only error-level rules, for a hook or a CI step that should block on nothing else.
content: .Level in ["error"]

name: no-spelling
description: Every rule but the spell checker, for a run over text full of names Vale doesn't know.
content: .Name != "Vale.Spelling"

name: no-suggestions
description: Errors and warnings only, for a CI step that should report what needs fixing and leave the rest to the editor.
content: .Level in ["error", "warning"]

name: spelling
description: Only the spell checkers, for building a vocabulary from what a first run flags.
content: .Extends == "spelling"

name: HeadingNumbers
description: Numbered headings, such as 1. and 1.2, that skip or repeat a number, for a script rule scoped to raw Markdown.

name: ListPunctuation
description: A list where some items end with a period and others don't, for a script rule scoped to raw Markdown.

name: github
description: GitHub Actions annotations, one per alert, so each shows on its line in the pull request.

name: gitlab
description: A GitLab Code Quality report, so alerts show in the merge request widget and the changes view.

name: jsonl
description: JSON Lines, one object per alert, for a tool or an agent that reads alerts one at a time.

name: junit
description: JUnit XML, a test case per alert, for a CI system that shows test reports but nothing else.

name: rdjsonl
description: reviewdog's rdjsonl, one diagnostic per line, for reviewdog to post as review comments.

name: sarif
description: SARIF 2.1.0, for code scanning, where each alert keeps a history and can be dismissed with a reason.

name: summary
description: A Markdown summary with a table per file and the totals, for a pull request comment or a job summary.

name: AndroidStrings
description: The text of each string and plural in an Android resource file, with names and untranslatable strings left alone.
content:
# Android string resources: the text of each `<string>` and of each `<item>`
# in a `<plurals>`, one element per line. Names, attributes, and strings
# marked `translatable="false"` are never linted.
#
#   [res/values/strings.xml]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = AndroidStrings
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value String (.*?)
  Value Plural (.*?)

  Start
    ^\s*<string\b[^>]*\btranslatable="false" -> Next
    ^\s*<string\b[^>]*>${String}</string> -> Record
    ^\s*<plurals\b -> Plurals

  Plurals
    ^\s*</plurals> -> Start
    ^\s*<item\b[^>]*>${Plural}</item> -> Record
scopes:
  - name: string
    expr: String

  - name: plural
    expr: Plural

name: AppleStrings
description: The values of an Apple .strings file, with the keys and comments left alone.
content:
# An Apple `.strings` file: the value of each `"key" = "value";` line. The
# keys and comments are never linted.
#
#   [*.strings]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = AppleStrings
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value Message ((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)

  Start
    ^\s*"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*=\s*"${Message}"\s*; -> Record
scopes:
  - name: message
    expr: Message

name: CRD
description: Every description in a Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinition's schema, read as Markdown.
content:
# A Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinition: every `description` in each
# version's `openAPIV3Schema`, read as Markdown.
#
#   [*.{yml,yaml}]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = CRD
engine: dasel
scopes:
  - name: description
    expr: 'search(has("openAPIV3Schema")).map(openAPIV3Schema).search(has("description")).map(description)'
    type: md

name: Commit
description: A commit message as a subject, a body, and trailers, each its own scope.
content:
# A commit message: a subject line, a blank line, a body, and trailers.
#
#   [COMMIT_EDITMSG]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = Commit
#
# Then, in a commit-msg hook: vale --path=COMMIT_EDITMSG < "$1"
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value Subject (.+)
  Value List Body (.*)
  Value List Trailer ([A-Z][\w-]+: .+)

  Start
    ^${Subject} -> Body

  Body
    ^${Trailer}
    ^${Body}
scopes:
  - name: subject
    expr: Subject

  - name: body
    expr: Body
    type: md

  - name: trailer
    expr: Trailer

name: GraphQL
description: The block and single-line descriptions in a GraphQL schema, read as Markdown.
content:
# A GraphQL schema: the descriptions before its types, fields, and
# arguments, block (`"""`) or single-line (`"`), read as Markdown.
#
#   [*.{graphql,graphqls}]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = GraphQL
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value List Description (.*)

  Start
    ^\s*"""${Description}"""\s*$
    ^\s*"""\s*$ -> Block
    ^\s*"""${Description}$ -> Block
    ^\s*"${Description}"\s*$

  Block
    ^\s*"""\s*$ -> Start
    ^\s*${Description}"""\s*$ -> Start
    ^\s*${Description}
scopes:
  - name: description
    expr: Description
    type: md

name: I18nJSON
description: Every string in an i18n JSON file, flat or nested, with the keys left alone.
content:
# An i18n JSON file: every string value, at any depth, flat keys or nested.
# The keys are never linted.
#
#   [locales/en.json]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = I18nJSON
engine: dasel
scopes:
  - name: message
    expr: search(true)

name: I18nYAML
description: Every string in a Rails-style locale file, with the keys left alone.
content:
# A Rails-style locale file, `en:` at the root and nested keys under it:
# every string value, at any depth. The keys are never linted.
#
#   [config/locales/en.yml]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = I18nYAML
engine: dasel
scopes:
  - name: message
    expr: search(true)

name: JSONSchema
description: Every title and description in a JSON Schema, written in JSON or YAML.
content:
# A JSON Schema, in JSON or YAML: every `title` and `description`, at any
# depth. A property that happens to be named `title` is left alone.
#
#   [*.schema.{json,yml,yaml}]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = JSONSchema
engine: dasel
scopes:
  - name: title
    expr: '[$this].search(has("title")).map(title)'

  - name: description
    expr: '[$this].search(has("description")).map(description)'

name: OpenAPI
description: The title and every description and summary in an OpenAPI document, read as Markdown.
content:
# An OpenAPI description: the title, and every `description` and `summary`
# field, which are Markdown by the specification.
#
#   [*.{yml,yaml}]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = OpenAPI
engine: dasel
scopes:
  - name: title
    expr: info.title

  - name: description
    expr: 'search(has("description")).map(description)'
    type: md

  - name: summary
    expr: 'search(has("summary")).map(summary)'
    type: md

name: Python
description: Comments and docstrings in Python source, read as Markdown.
content:
# Python source: comments and docstrings, read as Markdown.
#
#   [*.py]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = Python
engine: tree-sitter
scopes:
  - name: comment
    expr: (comment)+ @comment
    type: md

  - name: docstring
    expr: |
      ((function_definition
        body: (block . (expression_statement (string) @docstring)))
      (#offset! @docstring 0 3 0 -3))
    type: md

name: Subtitles
description: The cue text of a SubRip file, with the indexes and timings left alone.
content:
# SubRip subtitles: a cue is an index, a timing line, and one or more lines
# of text, separated by blank lines. Only the text is exposed.
#
#   [*.srt]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = Subtitles
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value Index (\d+)
  Value Timing (\d\d:\d\d:\d\d,\d\d\d --> \d\d:\d\d:\d\d,\d\d\d.*)
  Value List Cue (.+)

  Start
    ^${Index}$ -> Timing

  Timing
    ^${Timing}$ -> Cue

  Cue
    ^$ -> Record Start
    ^${Cue}
scopes:
  - name: cue
    expr: Cue

name: Transcript
description: A chat transcript, exposing only the model's turns so the prompts are never linted.
content:
# A chat transcript with `user:` and `assistant:` turns. Only the model's
# turns are exposed, so the prompts are never linted.
#
#   [*.txt]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = Transcript
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value List Assistant (.*)
  Value List User (.*)

  Start
    ^assistant: ${Assistant} -> Assistant
    ^user: ${User} -> User

  Assistant
    ^(?:user|assistant): -> Continue.Record
    ^assistant: ${Assistant}
    ^user: ${User} -> User
    ^${Assistant}

  User
    ^(?:user|assistant): -> Continue.Record
    ^user: ${User}
    ^assistant: ${Assistant} -> Assistant
    ^${User}
scopes:
  - name: assistant
    expr: Assistant
    type: md

name: WebVTT
description: The cue text of a WebVTT file, with the header, identifiers, timings, and notes left alone.
content:
# WebVTT captions: a header, then cues separated by blank lines, each an
# optional identifier, a timing line, and the text. Only the text is
# exposed; NOTE, STYLE, and REGION blocks are skipped.
#
#   [*.vtt]
#   BasedOnStyles = Vale
#   View = WebVTT
engine: textfsm
template: |
  Value Timing ((?:\d+:)?\d\d:\d\d\.\d\d\d --> .*)
  Value List Cue (.+)

  Start
    ^WEBVTT -> Header

  Header
    ^$ -> Block

  Block
    ^$ -> Next
    ^(?:NOTE|STYLE|REGION)(?:\s|$) -> Skip
    ^${Timing}$ -> Cue
    ^.+ -> Next

  Skip
    ^$ -> Block

  Cue
    ^$ -> Record Block
    ^${Cue}
scopes:
  - name: cue
    expr: Cue
